title: Enforce pinned object_id in press-agent announcement before single send

scope.goal: Make the unpark receipt's declared gate true: the pinned object_id must appear in the fixed announcement text, and the workflow must assert this on the exact text about to be sent, fail-closed, before delivery.
scope.scopeDecision: Minimal integrity repair (+7/-1, one file): object id line added to ANNOUNCEMENT; pre-send assertion added in the delivery step (checks the exact env text, exits nonzero without delivering on absence). confirm_send consumption (job-level if:) verified present and unchanged. No duplication of the announcement text (single source of truth).

notInScope: Executing the dispatch (separate authorized action after merge)
Any change to the unpark receipt, guard, or delivery count
Fixing the pre-existing npm audit baseline
Any deploy, wallet, or economic action
verification: Both inline node scripts pass node --check
Gate simulated locally against YAML-parsed ANNOUNCEMENT: object_id present = True; gist URL byte-intact = True
URL lines verified pure ASCII (no invisible characters)
definitionOfDone: PR checks: Publication Scope PASS; only the documented pre-existing verify-evidence-and-audit npm-audit baseline may fail
boundaryStatement: This repairs the truth of an existing declared gate; it does not authorize or execute the send. The single dispatch remains a separate, explicitly authorized workflow_dispatch action.
